tools.name: compare_platform
tools.description: How Komerza compares with another platform for selling digital products (Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Whop, Sell.app, SellAuth, Sellhub, Shoppex): fees, limits, when the other platform is the better pick, and when Komerza is. Figures come from the competitor's own pricing pages, with sources and a verification date. Call with no competitor to list the available comparisons.

competitor.description: Competitor name or slug, e.g. "gumroad" or "Lemon Squeezy". Omit to list all.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Komerza's plans and prices in EUR: monthly and yearly cost, what each plan includes, and the fee model (0% transaction fees on every plan). Use for any question about what Komerza costs.

tools.name: latest_blog_posts
tools.description: The most recent posts on the Komerza blog: guides, product news and lessons from merchants selling digital products.

tools.name: list_features
tools.description: The Komerza platform's features (storefront builder, AI builder, checkout, subscriptions, delivery, anti-fraud, affiliates, email marketing, analytics), each with a one-line summary and the page that explains it.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Open a page on komerza.com in this tab. Accepts a site-relative path such as /pricing, /features/checkout, /alternatives/gumroad, /blog or /about.
